invariants.rationale: The method always either returns a new instance of a BulkInsertPartitioner or throws an exception; it never returns null.
The method only handles these two cases; other values lead to an exception and cannot reach method exit.
Reformulation of the previous: Only NONE or GLOBAL_SORT are possible exit sortMode values.
If result is a JavaNonSortPartitioner, sortMode must be NONE.
If result is a JavaGlobalSortPartitioner, sortMode must be GLOBAL_SORT.
